Leaf mould bins

The council brings fallen leaves from the park to the site every autumn and tips them into the wire bins behind the hut. After two years the leaves have turned into leaf mould, and any member can take a barrow of it for their beds. Please take it from the oldest bin, which is the one nearest the path.

Marsh Lane Allotments, 4 Marsh Lane. Open from dawn to dusk.
